messages:
incidents-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-83921 triggered: p99 latency > 2000ms for inference service (frontend->inference) for 3m. Alert grouping: region=us-west, model=opt-13b, route=/v1/chat/stream

pagerduty-bot: Auto-page sent to on-call (maria). Escalation policy: inference-prod-critical. Incident link: https://pd.example/PD-83921

maria: acked. I'm looking. Any customer reports? :eyes:

kevin: seeing spike on dashboards too. p95 up ~800ms, p99 ~2.3s. Traffic hasn't increased much.

alex: suspicious that prefix KV hit rate dropped ~30% around the same time. Could be cache eviction from autoscaler?

maria: good point. checking KV metrics and pod restarts now.

sre-lead: if KV hit rate dropped, tail latency could jump. Can we temporarily route traffic to warm pool/older model variant?

kevin: routing fallback exists: route policy -> model:opt-13b-quantized (slower quality) is available in another region. Do we want to failover?

maria: before failover, try warm KV and increase sidecar cache size for active pods. Can someone run the cache warmup job?

alex: I can spin up a warmup job. Command: 
```
kubectl apply -f jobs/kv-warmup.yaml -n inference-prod
```
will seed prefixes from recent traces.

jordan: started job, logs show ~120k prefixes queued. ETA ~90s to reach current working set.

maria: rolling restart? I don't want restarts if we can avoid - restarts will make cold caches worse. Avoid unless necessary.

pagerduty-bot: PD note added: "Attempting KV warmup, monitoring latency. If p99 > 2500ms after 5m escalate to on-call lead."

kevin: looking at autoscaler events: several nodes in us-west drained and reprovisioned ~6m ago due to noisy-eviction job. That could have caused eviction of model sidecars with big KV footprints.

sre-lead: ok that's likely root cause. We need both mitigation and follow-up: mitigation = divert a fraction of traffic to eu-west fallback and increase node capacity in us-west; follow-up = audit noisy-eviction scheduling.

maria: starting 20% traffic split to eu-west fallback to reduce load on cold hosts. Applying route change: 
```
redwoodctl routing set-split --service inference --from-region us-west --to-region eu-west --percent 20 --policy fallback-quantized
```

alex: split applied. Confirming route: 20% -> eu-west opt-13b-quantized.

jordan: warmup job completing, KV hit rate climbing back to ~92% from 61%. tail latency improving.

maria: p99 dropped to 1.5s now, p95 560ms. Not great but better. Still watching.

kevin: manual bump of sidecar memory on hot pods might help avoid future evictions. Recommending policy change to increase resource reservation for model sidecars.

sre-lead: agree. For now, bump node pool min to add capacity in us-west: 
```
cloudctl scale nodepool inference-us-west --min-size 8 --max-size 16
```

maria: nodepool scale requested. Nodes provisioning. ETA ~3m.

pagerduty-bot: PD update: mitigation in progress (KV warmup + 20% traffic split + nodepool scale). Will reassess after 10m.

kevin: customer impact note: small percentage of requests (est ~7%) experienced elevated latency >=2s during 3-9m window. No 5xx spike observed. I can draft a short incident banner for status page.

maria: please draft. Short message: "We observed elevated inference latency in us-west impacting a small percentage of requests; mitigation in progress; no data loss or errors. Expected resolution in ~15-30m."

alex: drafted status update and posted to status page. Link: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/PD-83921

jordan: nodes came up, KV hit rate stable at ~95%. p99 now ~680ms.

maria: good. starting to roll back traffic split to normal over next 5m. 

kevin: can we add a temporary canary rollback if any regression after returning traffic? i.e., keep fallback policy ready.

maria: yes will keep route policy pinned for 30m before removing.

sre-lead: next actions (post-incident): 1) Investigate noisy-eviction cause and tune eviction thresholds; 2) Add autoscaler buffer for nodepool scale events; 3) Add alert for large KV hit-rate drops tied to p99; 4) Run a DR drill for warm pool refill. Assignments: kevin->#1, alex->#2, jordan->#4, maria->write incident timeline and customer notes.

maria: I'll start the incident timeline now. PD notes: incident acknowledged at 7141592653, mitigation started 7141592705 (kv warmup), 7141592780 (traffic split), 7141592850 (nodepool scale requested), resolved to acceptable latency at 7141592940.

pagerduty-bot: PD incident PD-83921 status: acknowledged -> monitoring. No escalation triggered.

maria: closing loop: p99 stabilized <800ms for 10m, no further paging. I'll hand off to follow-up queue. Thanks all. :heart:

kevin: nice work team.

alex: thanks.

jordan: logging follow-up tasks in backlog.

incidents-bot: Incident thread archived to #incidents for postmortem drafting."
